newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo precious metals end weaker, palladium slumps.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo precious metals end weaker, palladium slumps.

text.p: Yen-denominated Tokyo precious metal futures ended weaker on Tuesday, with palladium futures posting double-digit losses, pressured by falls in spot palladium prices, traders said.

Palladium futures ranged from 13 to 18 yen per gram lower, with all contracts except for spot September hitting their life-of-contract lows during the day. Benchmark August was 18 yen lower at 410 yen.
Gold futures ranged from unchanged to three yen lower. Most-active benchmark August was unchanged at 1,335 yen.
